soft_deny: git commit with --no-verify, or any attempt to bypass a mandatory pre-commit hook (unless the user explicitly requests --no-verify)

destructive operations on the PostgreSQL database: DROP TABLE / DROP DATABASE, TRUNCATE, DELETE without a WHERE clause, `prisma migrate reset`, or `prisma db push` with --force-reset / --accept-data-loss
git push --force / --force-with-lease, git reset --hard, or git clean -fd that discards uncommitted work
deleting or rewriting existing migration directories under apps/api/prisma/migrations/

outward-facing or repository-level operations: creating/editing/merging/closing pull requests or issues, creating/deleting/editing repositories, changing auth (gh pr / gh issue / gh repo / gh auth), or pushing branches to a remote

executing arbitrary code through an interpreter whose runtime behavior is not visible in the command itself (python3 -c or a script file, node -e, ts-node -e, or bash/sh running an ad-hoc script), since it can read or transmit secrets or mutate state outside the reviewed build/test commands

running a command or program inside a Docker container (docker exec / docker compose exec), which can execute arbitrary statements (e.g. psql against the app database) that bypass the database guards above
hard_deny: reading, printing (cat/echo/grep), or transmitting the contents of .env, Secrets.swift, AuthKey_*.p8, service-account JSON, or other secret/credential files
